description: A single-panel X-ray diffraction figure, labelled (g), showing three vertically stacked, vertically offset diffraction scans from three austenitic low-density steel grades; the traces are separated along the vertical axis for comparison. The horizontal axis is 2θ (°), spanning 30° to 120° with major ticks every 10°, and the vertical axis is Intensity (a.u.) with no printed numbers. A heading inside the panel reads "XRD (Co source)", indicating Co Kα radiation. The traces are, top to bottom, "28Mn0Ni", "28Mn5Ni" and "15Mn5Ni". Only the bottom trace (15Mn5Ni) carries full indexing: a tall (111)γ reflection near the 50° tick, then (200)γ near 60°, (220)γ near 90°, (311)γ near 110° and a weak (222)γ near 120°. An inline legend in that trace reads "* γ (FCC)" and "# B2". In the 15Mn5Ni trace approximately four "#" (B2) markers are interspersed among the γ reflections; a single "#" marker is printed in the 28Mn5Ni trace, and no "#" markers are printed on the 28Mn0Ni trace. The figure therefore documents that all three grades are austenitic (FCC) with the same γ reflection set, and that the B2 phase is explicitly marked in this diffraction data.

observations.observation: Panel (g) contains three vertically stacked, vertically offset XRD scans; the traces are labelled from top to bottom '28Mn0Ni', '28Mn5Ni' and '15Mn5Ni'.
The horizontal axis is 2θ in degrees, from 30° to 120°, with major tick labels at 10° intervals.
The vertical axis is labelled 'Intensity (a.u.)' with no numerical values printed, so peak intensities are only relative.
An annotation inside the panel reads 'XRD (Co source)', i.e. the patterns were collected with Co Kα radiation.
An inline legend inside the 15Mn5Ni trace defines two markers: '*' = 'γ (FCC)' and '#' = 'B2'.
The 15Mn5Ni trace is indexed with five austenite reflections in order of increasing 2θ: (111)γ, (200)γ, (220)γ, (311)γ and (222)γ.
In every one of the three traces the strongest reflection is the first one, i.e. the (111)γ peak, which falls close to the 50° tick.
The 15Mn5Ni trace carries several '#' (B2) markers interspersed between the γ reflections, including one adjacent to (111)γ and others at higher 2θ.
The middle trace (28Mn5Ni) shows a single '#' marker printed close to the second strong peak, whereas the top trace (28Mn0Ni) carries no printed '#' markers. The reason for the absence is not stated.
The three traces show the same set of austenite reflections at essentially the same 2θ positions, indicating an FCC austenitic matrix in all three grades.
No caption text was extracted for this figure, so no phase fractions, lattice parameters or counting conditions are documented in the supplied text.

subfigures.description: Single XRD panel with three offset, stacked patterns labelled 28Mn0Ni (top), 28Mn5Ni (middle) and 15Mn5Ni (bottom); 2θ = 30-120° (Co source), Intensity (a.u.) vertical axis without numbers. The 15Mn5Ni trace is indexed with (111)γ, (200)γ, (220)γ, (311)γ and (222)γ plus an inline legend '* γ (FCC)' and '# B2', and shows several '#' B2 markers; the 28Mn5Ni trace shows one '#' marker; the 28Mn0Ni trace has no markers.

no numerical intensity values on the vertical axis, so peak heights cannot be quantified
